focus_area: ExtractJobCriteriaJob retry_on + exhaustion block + StandardError rescue + completion broadcast (SPEC §7)
method: rails runner under RAILS_ENV=test with ActiveJob::Base.queue_adapter=:test, ActiveJob::TestHelper, AiJobApplicationAction::Scoring::ExtractCriteria#extract monkeypatched to raise/succeed (no real OpenAI), and GlobalChannel.broadcast_to captured. 32 assertions across 6 scenario variants; all PASS.

scenarios_verified.1_retry_not_exhausted: CustomErrorAiSummary raised once -> perform_now did not re-raise (retry_on handled it); job RE-ENQUEUED (enqueued_jobs grew to 1, args [row_id, org_user_id]); NO broadcast on the retry; row stayed non-terminal (retrying), proving the StandardError rescue did NOT catch CustomErrorAiSummary.
scenarios_verified.2_exhaustion_with_requesting_id: Extractor always raises CustomErrorAiSummary; perform_enqueued_jobs drove all 3 attempts (performed_jobs==3) then the exhaustion block ran WITHOUT raising (no NoMethodError on job.arguments.first/second); row ends status=failed with error_message=error&.message; EXACTLY ONE broadcast with action=JOB_CRITERIA_EXTRACTION_COMPLETE, payload.status=failed, zeroCriteriaFailure=false, errorMessage present, delivered to the requesting user.
scenarios_verified.3_exhaustion_no_requesting_id: Args [row_id] and [row_id, nil] both: row ends status=failed (failure still written) but NO broadcast (nil requesting id -> OrganizationUser.find_by(id: nil) is nil -> broadcast_completion returns early).
scenarios_verified.4_standard_error: Plain RuntimeError: with requesting id -> row failed, error_message=e.message, NO retry enqueued (RuntimeError not retryable), exactly ONE broadcast status=failed; without requesting id -> row failed, NO broadcast. perform_now did not re-raise.
scenarios_verified.5_custom_error_precedence: rescue CustomErrorAiSummary precedes rescue StandardError in perform; CustomErrorAiSummary is re-raised and handled by retry_on rather than caught/terminal-failed by the StandardError rescue (confirmed structurally and by Scenario 1 re-enqueue + non-failed row).
